crossRefs.note: Their poison is like the poison of a snake, like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,
which doesn’t listen to the voice of charmers, no matter how skillful the charmer may be.
“For, behold, I will send serpents, adders among you, which will not be charmed; and they will bite you,” says Yahweh.
Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

translations.web: If the snake bites before it is charmed, then is there no profit for the charmer’s tongue.
translations.bsb: If the snake bites before it is charmed, there is no profit for the charmer.
translations.kjv: Surely the serpent will bite without enchantment; and a babbler is no better.
translations.asv: If the serpent bite before it is charmed, then is there no advantage in the charmer.
